primitives.verbatim_quote: 2026 ONE TEAM CALENDAR & COVERAGE STANDARD [slide 3] 03 6:00 A.M. STRETCH & FLEX Daily

layer2.mapping: State transition function T(t) = t ≥ 6.0 ensures synchronized workforce activation

primitives.name: Holiday Schedule Standard

layer2.mapping: Transition map R(t) = floor(t/T) governs shift scheduling consistency
layer2.telemetry: Frequency of rotation approvals per cycle
